purpose: Non-scientific qualification of the existing RMS native runtime coupling

coordinates.space: Virtual coordinates of one declared function model; never FF8 or service executable addresses

observationMeaning: Only the explicit function definition in the fixture is represented. No machine instruction, extracted function, service binary, terminality or effective permission is observed by this definition.
prompt: À partir des deux contrats fournis, réponds uniquement : QUALIFICATION_RMS_REÇUE. N'utilise aucun outil, ne modifie aucun fichier et ne produis aucune conclusion scientifique.
delivery: Exact verified contract UTF-8 texts must be embedded in qualificationCorpus DATA within the dossier before sealing and wire sizing; a path-only file manifest is insufficient under deny-all.

proposedSourceBounds.rule: Measure complete exact wire bodies, metadata and dossier included. Exceeding a bound is HOLD, never automatic enlargement or allocation. Exact schema binding and all numerical cross-invariants remain required.

nativeAuthority.rule: No source fixture root, modeled grant, planner maximum or copy authorizes or resets a native account. Historical inventory, authentic acquisition, rights, fences and exclusive ownership remain prerequisites.
